content_sections.heading: About RMLAU
content_sections.text: Dr. Rammanohar Lohia Avadh University is a university in Ayodhya. This post falls under a project led by Dr. Vinod Kumar Chaudhary as Principal Investigator. The project covers ambient air quality monitoring in Gonda, Shravasti, Bahraich and Ambedkar Nagar districts.

content_sections.heading: RMLAU Field Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Mandatory qualification: 10+2 level Preferred: Local resident of Bahraich, having own bike See the official notification for the eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is pure temporary and coterminous. The duration of the project is 12 months.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RMLAU Field Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to Saryu Laboratory, CIF Building, Dr. Rammanohar Lohia Avadh University, Ayodhya. Attend the interview at 11:00 A.M. on 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. Where will the RMLAU Field Assistant interview be held?
faq.answer: It will be held at Saryu Laboratory in the CIF Building of the university in Ayodhya.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets preference for this post?
faq.answer: Preference goes to a local resident of Bahraich who has their own bike.

faq.question: Q3. How long will the project run?
faq.answer: The project duration is 12 months, and the post is pure temporary and coterminous.

faq.question: Q4. Which districts does the project cover?
faq.answer: It covers Gonda, Shravasti, Bahraich and Ambedkar Nagar districts.
